skippercast_context.source: Repo github.com/Grahammmm/skippercast at commit fa9c3581 (2026-11-19), README.md, docs/roadmap.md ('What ships now'), docs/web-app.md, docs/boat-profile.md, web/map/layers.ts, catalog/app/strings.json; live site https://skippercast.com (HTTP 200).
skippercast_context.what_it_is: Phone-first web app (v0.8, pre-beta): fishing map + ocean forecast for boat anglers on California's Central Coast. MapLibre + PMTiles on a self-hosted Protomaps basemap, NOAA ENC chart, 2D/3D terrain. Morro Bay & Avila active; 15 regions preview; 6 SoCal draft. Bottomfish/reef focus (habitat candidates, rules), not offshore pelagics.
has: Per-layer basis sentence with source, product/grid and age; layers withheld past age limits; /status data-freshness page
Forecast skill page (/skill) and in-brief measured-skill line vs buoys
Shareable links that reopen region, port, profile, day, hour, target, view, layers, base
7-day hourly time dock (169 samples) scrubs/plays forecast layers; Conditions view compares NOAA (GFS/GFS-Wave) vs ECMWF (IFS/WAM) and states disagreement
Boat profile (AI spec lookup or manual) scaling an hourly conditions score; day verdict Comfortable/Marginal/Rough/Unknown with the limiting factor

Layers: water temp + 0.5 °F contours, SST contrast, SST fronts with uncertainty band, chlorophyll (NOAA OCI, dated), currents (WCOFS / HF radar, animated), swell, wind, clouds, seafloor habitat, relief, depth contours, MPAs, charter grounds, commercial AIS
Where to look: ranked habitat places with up to 3 dated, sourced reasons
Boat run: run time at your cruise speed by water route, turn-back time, bar-crossing leave-by/be-back-by at Morro Bay
Saved-trip alerts (passkey account) when the assessment materially changes and the day before; home-port alert
Saved spots (up to 100), private catch/effort log, comfort feedback
Offline trip pack (ENC tiles + data, service worker); GPX/share-sheet/offline-notes export; every exported place screened against protected areas
Rules cards and season calendar from CDFW; Reports view (dated catch cards, charter evidence); English + Spanish
Text Advisor (SMS/Instagram advisor, skipper reports, fish ID, daily 'what's biting') built but switched off
lacks_not_found_in_repo: Tap-to-read on every layer at once: today one reading at a time for water temp, contrast, currents, fronts and swell, and none for chlorophyll or wind. No user-adjustable colour ramp: the SST ramp auto-fits the analysis range but can't be fitted to the view or set by hand.
Playback of past days for observed layers (time dock runs forward hourly; History view is station history only)
Chlorophyll edges and eddy detection (fronts exist for SST only); sea surface height/altimetry
Subsurface temperature, thermocline, mixed layer depth, salinity, dissolved oxygen
Threshold alerts on a saved spot's water, and new-satellite-pass alerts
Heading-dependent ride (boat model explicitly ignores heading); ride/track recording that feeds the boat model
Conditions recorded at each catch (catch log stores outcome + optional position only)
Fuel estimate (explicitly left to the skipper); GPX import in the UI (a parser exists in web/gpx-waypoints.ts, unwired)
Native App Store / Google Play apps; broad active coverage (one active region vs competitors' 15–34)
Offshore pelagic species modes / habitat suitability (by design it ranks habitat, not catch odds)
skippercast_context.note: Graham's phrases 'subsea weather' and 'raw general base layer map' don't appear in the repo; the closest layers are currents/water temp and basemap + ENC + seafloor.

feature_recommendations.detail: Tap any point for the exact water temp, chlorophyll, swell or current value; range slider and 'fit to view' on the legend.
feature_recommendations.why: Partly shipped: web/map/chart.ts reads one value at a tap for water temp, contrast, currents, fronts and swell, and none for chlorophyll or wind. The SST ramp auto-fits the analysis range, but users can't fit it to the view or set it. Cheapest upgrade to every raster layer.

feature_recommendations.detail: Extend the time dock 3–7 days into the past for SST, fronts and chlorophyll so users watch a front move, then continue into the forecast.
feature_recommendations.why: The time dock only runs forward hourly; History is station-only.

feature_recommendations.feature: Water-condition alerts on saved spots + new-data alerts
feature_recommendations.detail: 'Tell me when water at this spot is above 58 °F' and 'new chlorophyll sample landed', on the existing passkey account and alert pipeline.
feature_recommendations.why: Saved-trip alerts already exist; spot thresholds reuse that plumbing.

feature_recommendations.detail: Add a heading rose to the boat verdict and use comfort feedback (and optional phone-motion ride recording) to calibrate the boat multipliers.
feature_recommendations.why: docs/boat-profile.md says the model ignores heading and names comfort feedback as the calibration path. Comfort feedback already stores heading, phase, wind, sea and period. RideScore ships both.

feature_recommendations.detail: Add detected chlorophyll edges and eddy outlines beside the existing SST fronts, plus a sea-surface-height layer.
feature_recommendations.why: SST fronts and contrast already ship with uncertainty bands; the other edges are missing.

feature_recommendations.detail: When a catch-log entry has a position and time, store the layer values there (temp, chlorophyll, swell, current, tide) and show them back; optional track recording.
feature_recommendations.why: Catch log stores outcome + optional position only; joining it to layers builds SkipperCast's own evidence.

feature_recommendations.feature: Subsurface depth ladder (if 'subsea weather' means below-surface)
feature_recommendations.detail: Temperature at 10–100 m, thermocline/MLD, salinity, labelled as model output, switched like a depth slider.
feature_recommendations.why: Not in the repo; its water-temp basis says it is 'neither bottom temperature nor a forecast'. Confirm Graham's intent first.

feature_recommendations.feature: Small trip-plan gaps: GPX import, optional fuel estimate
feature_recommendations.detail: Import waypoints from chartplotters; optional fuel = run distance × burn the user enters.
feature_recommendations.why: GPX export, run time and a worst-hour line in the brief already exist. A GPX waypoint parser exists (web/gpx-waypoints.ts) but no UI uses it. Fuel is deliberately left to the skipper today.

feature_recommendations.feature: Launch the built Text Advisor / AI briefing
feature_recommendations.detail: Owner launch steps only; it already covers reports, rules, fish ID and daily 'what's biting'.
feature_recommendations.why: Competitors ship AI briefings now; SkipperCast's is built but dark.

feature_recommendations.detail: Move preview regions to active (SoCal first, where Fish or Pass operates) and consider a store-listed wrapper app.
feature_recommendations.why: One active region vs 15–34 for competitors; every rival here is in the App Store.

x_signal.note: Indie Android app scoring any spot from NOAA SST, EMODnet depth, Open-Meteo (800+ species). Small account; signal that solo devs are building 'score any spot' apps.
Coverage of SiriusXM Fish Mapping app at $199/yr without a satellite plan.
Opinion: 'weather/fishing app market has commoditized; value is in producing new, better data' — supports SkipperCast's raw-telemetry angle.
